title: Apple Prepares Potential Security Camera Features for Smart Hub
excerpt: Code discovered in HomeView hints that Apple may soon introduce security camera features to its smart home hub.
body_html:
Recent code findings suggest that Apple might introduce new security camera capabilities to its smart home hub. Code strings uncovered in HomeView version 27.2 point toward the potential addition of a security camera mode.

According to findings shared by a Reddit user, the uncovered software strings detail features such as live streaming, motion detection, and recording options. The code also outlines privacy functions and includes references to a setup page.

These references indicate that the company is exploring expanded monitoring tools for its smart home ecosystem, though official details regarding a release or formal announcement have not been provided.
